prerequisites: 全新隔离 schema；客户端保留逐语句输出及错误日志

target_saved_classification_reason: utf16 QUOTE(NULL)显示乕䱌，HEX为4E554C4C且CHARSET=utf16、IS NULL=0；latin1相同字节正确为NULL文本。

comparison_rules.normal: QUOTE(NULL) renders literal text NULL, not SQL NULL, for both latin1 and utf16; nonnull value renders quoted NOTNULL.
comparison_rules.same_target_anomaly: utf16 QUOTE(NULL) renders 乕䱌, with HEX4E554C4C labelled utf16 and IS NULL=0.
comparison_rules.case_gates: Postcheck utf16 rowcount2 nullcount1; distinguish encoded text from SQL NULL using HEX/CHARSET/IS NULL.
comparison_rules.unknown: Syntax/unsupported feature errors, failed setup/postcheck, timeouts/OOM/connection errors, mismatching environment, uncomparable plan or any other unexplained result are unknown; never normal.
comparison_rules.conclusion: Previous normal plus validated target abnormal => observed_new_at_release; same anomaly on previous => pre_existing; otherwise unknown.
